terms.AssertionRecord: Supplementary extraction envelope; not a new native class.
terms.reportedValue: Exact source-reported selected percent cell, not a RiskScore or recomputed estimate.
terms.standardErrorPercent: Selected source standard error; absent stays absent rather than zero.
terms.totalPaths: Selected source denominator where available; no invented Table 1 count.
terms.unit: Supplementary literal percent, distinct from native measurement/unit semantic admission.
terms.disposition: CORRECTED_VALUE or REISSUED_UNCHANGED; lineage does not imply a numeric change.
terms.correctsSource: Source-level correction DOI points to original DOI, based on the actual notice; no independent corroboration.
terms.independentStudyLineages: One underlying study lineage for the original/corrigendum pair; duplicate table presentations add none.
terms.RawScenarioRecord: Unadmitted documentary staging record; not a managed RiskScenarioSpecification.
terms.caseAdmission: Preserved prior WITHHELD decision, not reopened by this task.
terms.occurrenceAsserted: False describes this pipeline's lack of occurrence assertion, not proof that a real event did not happen.
terms.priorRecord: Link to the already inspected rc.6 source record; preserves its source/adjudication identity.

external_metadata.http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasRevisionOf: Revision between our curated assertion envelopes, not a native correction predicate or assertion that the two publication DOIs are versions of one native artifact.
external_metadata.http://purl.org/dc/terms/source: Distinct original/correction DOI or inherited hospital DOI.
external_metadata.http://purl.org/dc/terms/title: Display only; equal titles do not merge identities.

native_projection: CQ07 versions are versions of our curated cell assertion artifacts, not of the source publications. CQ08 documentary candidates reuse native InformationArtifact typing only; no native scenario/case or event is admitted. Invalid native R-36 links appear only in explicitly synthetic rejection/control graphs.
raw_query_boundary: SELECT returns asserted graph bindings, including false/conflicting bindings. Separate exact frozen-cohort checks enforce the named inspection tasks. Neither query nor cohort syntax proves source truth, real-world nonexistence or general semantic validity.
execution: Local RDFLib 7.6.0 SELECT; no inference, remote service, imports or identifier normalization. Automated replay uses hash-bound selected public data, not new primary PDF reading.
